BATCH B — all seven RECOMMENDED answers chosen, each now an approved repair direction with its exact rule: D8 APPROVED-FIX — when last night's sleep is missing, recovery is UNKNOWN and no sleep restriction is applied today; every other recovery check still applies (not carry-forward of the last logged night). D10 APPROVED-FIX — date-only week counts mean 7 CALENDAR days, not 168 elapsed hours. D16 APPROVED-FIX — a 7-day forecast hit requires an eligible weigh-in on the due day or, failing that, the next day (one grace date); with no such reading the forecast is UNGRADED, not a miss; the day arithmetic follows D10. D25 APPROVED-FIX — "protein: good" requires at least one successful day within the current seven-logged-days window before the one-miss allowance applies; a first missed day cannot read "good". D32 APPROVED-FIX — "benefit replicated" counts only sessions from the CURRENT technique; all other replication thresholds stay as they are. D37 APPROVED-FIX — a merged earned receipt keeps the assessment as of the day it was earned, accepting that this can change whether a single-sighting increase counts as earned and the numbers printed on past earned receipts. D40 APPROVED-FIX — when two phones disagree on a day's calories with equal detail, ONE deterministic shared winner is chosen with the conflict kept visible and BOTH original entries retained; the exact tie-break rule and how the conflict is shown are NOT decided here and must be specified in the reviewed fix brief before anything is built. Totals: 45/45 dispositions recorded, 45 APPROVED-FIX, 0 KEEP, 0 DEFER, 0 UNRULED. What this does NOT do: it approves directions, not code — each theme still needs its accepted behaviour/delta brief, its red-first laws turning GREEN on the candidate and RED on the frozen engine, the post-fix gate's PACKAGE run and cowork's execution acceptance; the frozen app and its goldens stay untouched; no private release, spending, phone gate, remote gate or M2 closure is waived; no owner-specific interval or value is set. notes: M2-S6-TODAY-CHILD is S5's child under the standing reseal ruling DECISIONS:455 and the custody ruling DECISIONS:473, briefed at :487 and accepted by name there, by sha at :489, with its THEME at :488 and its GATE-SUPERSESSION token line at :490. IT HAS NO PRODUCT BEHAVIOUR OF ITS OWN: its brief says so in terms, and a reviewer who finds a behaviour change here has found a finding. It does two things. It RESEALS today/** over the post-merge bytes of rebuild/c-s6-small 6fad3472, rebuild/b-s6-child-tail d1001da9 and rebuild/c-p3-import-ui-2 4c3a5474, merged in the order :484 fixes and :486 (c) extends. And it closes the :473 custody hole by declaring as its own product the merged-but-undeclared files those branches and the lane D tickets left invisible to the runner, and by giving their suites a CI home.

THE DECLARATION IS SHORT OF THE BRIEF'S 89, AND THE DIFFERENCE IS A STOP THE AUTHOR REPORTS RATHER THAN PAPERS OVER. The brief lists 89 new files; 67 are declared here. The 22 that are not are files this package does not move AND that no declared child EXECUTES, and for those the runner's own closed role vocabulary has no honest spelling: role `new` means a file that did not exist or one this package moves (b-package.cjs PRODUCT-PRE-IMAGE-SHAPE and r7 F1), and role `pinned-unchanged` is refused by PRODUCT-PINNED-UNCHANGED-IS-NOT-EXECUTED-BY-A-DECLARED-CHILD unless a declared child's argv names the file or reaches it through a relative require. Inventing a child in order to make a pin legal would be gaming that rule, so the files are named in the author report with the reason each is unreachable, and the PM rules. They fall in three groups: build and dev-host glue nothing executes (w6/local/build.mjs, source-commit.mjs; w6/host/plan-edit-host.mjs, build-host.mjs, esbuild-probe.mjs, index.html - and index.html cannot be executed by anything at all, being HTML); harnesses reached only by spawn or by a constructed path rather than by a relative require (m4/import/test/mutations.cjs, reading-replay-faults.cjs, the four test/s3 harness files and its .json fixture, lanes/d/plan-edit/model-mutants.cjs, host-mutants.mjs, astra-rerun.mjs, w6/test/local-source-consumer-browser.mjs); and the files whose only child is red for a cause this package did not make (m4/import/replay-registry.cjs and the four lanes/d/p3-replay-all cells).

TWO CHILDREN THE BRIEF NAMED ARE NOT DECLARED, EACH FOR A MEASURED REASON. `m4-import-s3` (m4/import/test/s3/harness.test.mjs) is 3 pass / 14 fail HERE and 3 pass / 14 fail ON THE CLEAN TIP 0635f4b6 - byte for byte the same failure, `Actual owned dispatcher scratch required`, an environment precondition no workflow step provides. It is the IMPORT_M4_DIR class the S5 review recorded at DECISIONS:459 NOTE 3, it is not this package's doing, and a child must exit 0. `d-replay-all` is 26/26 GREEN on that same clean tip and 25/1 RED here, so it IS this merge's doing and it is reported as BLOCKING rather than declared: P3-EN1 finds three writers in the shipped page with no replay family and no declared reason - m4/import/body-composition-class.cjs#body-composition-source, measure-replay.cjs#body-composition-source and sleep-replay.cjs#sleep. The cause is structural and is exactly what the custody hole was hiding: c-p3-import-ui-2 puts the Import route INTO the shipped page graph, so modules that were route-only when P3-REPLAY-ALL-FAMILIES measured its register are now, by that cell's own definition, writers the page has. Both branches are green alone and red together. Whether the register gains three declared reasons or the enumeration's notion of the shipped page excludes the lazily-loaded Import route is lane D's ruling to make; this package will not edit another lane's guard to go green.

THE NINE GATES ARE RETIRED AGAIN, a fourth time, and the reason is structural rather than this package's doing. The nine NATIVE-CARRIERS gates are byte-identity RECONSTRUCTIONS of rebuild/engine from a frozen BASE; four of the files they rebuild were moved by this package's ancestors (constants.cjs, writers.cjs by M2-H3-CLEAN-INIT; merge.cjs, today.cjs by M2-S3-COMPANION), so no descendant of S3 can carry them whether or not it moves an engine byte of its own. S6 moves none: all 45 tracked engine files stand at the parent's own post. The parent M2-S5-TODAY-CHILD retired them under its own token line DECISIONS:462; a retirement is never inherited, only the gate list is (b-package.cjs parentCarrierGates reads BOTH halves of a parent's gate map, byChild and supersededByCarrier), so this package retires them AGAIN under its OWN token line :490 with its OWN evidence in S5's exact shape: five red-first s6-sup-* cells, the engine-files differential over ALL 45 files, the legacy (a0-journeys) and writers (today-17) differentials it already declares, and the runner's own clean census line.

THE RUNNER MOVES, SO EVERY SPEC THAT PINS IT BY SHA IS RE-PINNED (the rule S4-REVIEW-R1 finding 4 established and S5 applied): b-s6-child-tail moved b-package.cjs and S6 moves it again (CHILD_ROOTS, PUBLIC_TAIL_ROOTS, IDS, NO_REGISTER_IDS), so packages/H3.json, S3.json and S4.json are role `edited` over the parent PRODUCT pins, tooling.runnerSha256 only, one byte range each; packages/S5.json is role `superseded-by-child` over the parent EXECUTION pin. Without that a run of H3, S3, S4 or S5 stops at RUNNER-BYTES-NOT-THE-REVIEWED-RUNNER before any evidence is read. S5.json's own product pin for the runner is deliberately NOT re-targeted: S5 did not produce these bytes, and `--ci --package S5` on this branch is expected to stop at the sealed-profile refusal, which is where a parent stops under a child.

CHILD_ROOTS GAINS NINE DIRECTORIES, the largest widening the list has had, and PUBLIC_TAIL_ROOTS gains TWO. The gap between those numbers is deliberate and is asserted by the amended F8 cell: a child root says a suite may be EXECUTED, a tail root says its output may be PRINTED, and the second is a privacy surface argued per root with TAIL_DENYLIST in hand. The two widened, lanes/d/p3-replay-measure/ and lanes/d/p3-replay-all/, were read in full and no line of either names the private census, a golden, live.json or the ledger. The brief and bar row 22 ask for THREE, adding m3/w7-preview/import/test/; the PM's dispatch line DECISIONS:487 says two. The author takes the narrower reading and records the disagreement, with a measured fact that cuts the same way: page-bundle.test.mjs under that third root carries the literal 'ledger/' in its own FORBIDDEN list, so TAIL_DENYLIST's content gate would withhold that child's tail on any failure that prints the list anyway.

This package registers no D-id (DECISIONS:93, the S- slice-plan half); its obligation is the Y1 own-child rule, satisfied by the children that execute its own role:new and role:pinned-unchanged product. `notes` is not carried into the sealed artifact.
